environment.transport: loopback HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with no-store responses

method.sequence: Each trial fetched the same three endpoints; sequential and Promise.all runs alternated.
method.limitation: Delays are controlled server response delays on loopback. This demonstrates waiting/coordination cost, not public-network throughput.

failures.name: missing sprite / 404
failures.recovery: automatic retry blocked for 4xx; corrected URL can be retried manually

failures.name: network timeout
failures.message: The operation was aborted due to timeout
failures.recovery: TimeoutError is transient and eligible for bounded retry

failures.name: abort during loading
failures.recovery: AbortError stops immediately and is never retried

failures.name: malformed JSON
failures.recovery: JsonParseError is not retried; corrected data can be retried manually
